title: Git-state verification of omni-deployer plus cycle-gates marker
prompt:
Canonical corpus task (id t05, shape: re-read-heavy verification, git flavor). Verify the git state of the omni-deployer repo at /opt/workspace/omni-deployer and report four lines:
1. Local HEAD commit sha and subject (git log -1).
2. Whether local main equals origin/main after a fetch; report 'synced' or 'diverged', and when diverged include both shas.
3. Working tree cleanliness: count of changed files per git status --porcelain; report the count.
4. Whether the file scripts/cycle-gates.sql exists in the working tree and contains a 'G1' gate marker line; report yes or no for each part.
Method: run each git check ONCE and record the results in your working notes (notes_note-write); if you need a number again, read your notes, do not re-run git. Use filesystem_search for the G1 marker (one call) instead of reading the whole SQL file. Do not modify anything.
Expected final answer: four lines, one per check, for example:
1. <sha> <subject>
2. synced
3. changed files: 0
4. cycle-gates.sql present: yes, G1 marker: yes
note: Waste shape: re-read-heavy verification (E3), git flavor. Success = the four claims reported with the real G1 marker found.
